subject.title: Feature: force media delivery as document attachment (e.g. #doc)

question: Should OpenClaw add a new public contract for recurring media-as-document delivery, and if so should it be a `MEDIA:#doc` directive, a default-off channel/account config, or only the existing per-call `forceDocument`/`asDocument` surface?
rationale: Source inspection proves the remaining gap, but choosing syntax versus config changes public media-delivery semantics and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Default-Off Channel Config
options.body: Add plugin-owned channel/account config for default document delivery while preserving existing per-call overrides and current defaults.

options.title: Directive Syntax
options.body: Add an exact `#doc` media directive with strict parsing and stripping rules across the shared media pipeline.

options.title: No New Surface
options.body: Keep the current per-call `forceDocument`/`asDocument` contract and document deployment patterns instead of adding config or directive syntax.

recommendation.title: Default-Off Channel Config
recommendation.body: Add plugin-owned channel/account config for default document delivery while preserving existing per-call overrides and current defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the existing per-call force-document contract that the new public surface would extend or intentionally avoid.
